answer: Every piece of honest work can be traced to a name, and every name sits in a book. Chairmaker rush book with chairmakers attestation is the book that does the tracing: six-year book, 2,500 chairs framed, rush accounts, annual review. Sell work under a borrowed pulse and the sale is undone, the seller refunds the buyer twice the price and the willow is forfeited to the town, while the relic is preserved in the register and shown at the yearly visitation.
